539)phur pa yang gsang sgrub pa'i smad las dang byang gter dang bdud 'dul sri mnan dbal mdos bcas sbrel tshul bzhugs/ /540)bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag

tei:div.tei:p: 539) phur pa yang gsang sgrub pa'i smad las dang byang gter dang bdud 'dul sri mnan dbal mdos bcas sbrel tshul bzhugs// 540) bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/

'dir mkhas grub chags med rin po che'i rjes su 'brangs nas gter gzhung dngos gtsang dang chags med gsung yin nges rnams gab sprad nas 'daun pa'i dbang du btang na/ rnying sngon/ spos phyung*/ skyabs sems/ yan bcu/ maṇḍal/ bgegs gtor/ las byang bgegs bskrad nas/ mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ taṃ/ bar dang*/ mdun bskyed/ dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad rjes su/ prad khrid kyis sras phur bskyed/ mdun bskyed gnas gsum byin rlabs nas/ bzhugs par gyur: bar/ las byang*/ oṃ badzra= sogs/ spyan 'dren nas/ sbyor mchod rjes/ bstod pa zur 'geb sbyar/ gsol 'debs/ las byang dzabda bskul/ pra khrid kyi ye shes lha bsnyen dmigs pa/ bdag dang sras mchog= nas/ e khung gsal bar gyur/ ki la ya 'bru bcu gsum bsnyen/ dam can bsnyen dmigs/ bdag dang sras mchog= lhag ma med par gyur/ bzhi snying gcig dril bzla/ spu gri'i dmigs pa dug phur gnad 'phyang gi phur srung bcu gnyis= brlag par gyur/ yang na/ dug phur gyi/ bdag dpal sras mchog= las byed par gyur/ gang mos kyis/ spu gri bzla/ lhag chad kha skong*/ stong tshig mchod bstod dge bsngo bcas/ mdun bskyed kyi tshogs byin rlabs nas/ tshogs mchod rjes su gnam chos gtor bsngo bskang thung gnyis dang*/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ rgyal ba'i spyi skong*/ gzhung bskang rgyas bsdus gang rigs gcig bar bshags/ mdos 'phyang / 541) phur gsol cha tshang*/ dug phur gyi/ bdag dpal chen por gsal bar gyur/ kī la ya gsham can nyer gcig tsam bzla/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las= sor stsol cig byang gter sri rabs/ mdun bskyed/ oṃ badzra rakā du khaṃ= sogs nas 'gugs pa/ bden chung dgu/ rtsa rgyud gsum/ bdag gi thugs ka= ho ho ho/ bar dang*/ bdud 'dul sri mnan 'gugs dmigs/ 'gugs pa gsum/ byur sri'i sngags 'go mas 'gugs sngags tshar dgu sogs dgos skabs/ byang gter 'gugs pa / rtsa brgyud bla ma= gsum/

sri mo dga' yin sngags tshan gsum bzla/ lhan thabs dmigs pa/ sems dpa' sangs rgyas= gaṇḍe ho/ dug phur gyi/ bdag dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas= dngos su bris par gyur/ spu gri gzhug 'bring po la/ dgra bgegs dam sri byur sri phung sri'i bla khug aṅgu sha dzaḥ sbyar ba bzla/ spro na rig 'dzin bskul pa/ bstod pa zur 'gebs sras mchog yan la/ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i= rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las= sbyar ba dang*/ bskul byang dug mda' nag po yongs rdzogs/ dug phur gyi/ kye/ bdag ni ma nyes ma yo= mdzod/ bar/ spro na byang gter mkhyen pa sku/ mdun bskyed/ lha dbye/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po= dang*/ spu gri'i ming gzhung 'bring po la/ dgra bgegs nri tṛ dzaḥ shag phyes sbyar ba'i mthar / dgra bgegs 542) bgegs ha sa ya= phrol cig bar sbrel ba/ ho ho nyams pa'i dgra bgegs= gyur cig zhes dang*/ dug phur gyi/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi= ring cing 'dug par gyur/ byang gter gu gul sbyar ba'i sngags bcas le tshan gsum/ bdud 'dul gzer sngags/ spu gri la/ byur sri dam sri bsnyab pa= sogs dgu tsam/ dril thun rgyud kyi le'u bzhi pa'i/ dam tshig chen po'i= hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bar/ bdud 'dul mnan sngags/ lokt+ri can/ dgu lnga gang rung*/ hūm̐ bhyo: dam sri bya ba'i= sogs nas/ nan: bar/ khro bo 'bar ba'i= ༈ thun gnyis pa dzabda bsnyen bskyur ba dang*/ brub bskyed nas 'don lugs sngar ltar la/ dug mda' le'u lnga pa dang*/ lha dbye la thun gzung*/ ༈ thun gsum pa ni/ dug mda' le'u dang po/ spu gri'i gsham sbyar/ dgu tsam lha dbye dang*/ 'dug par gyur/ 'phros/ mdun bskyed gzugs dbab tshigs bcad rjes/ spu gri la/ dgra bgegs dzaḥhūm̐: sbyar ba thun gzung*/ smad las dug phur gyi/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa klu rgyal 'jog po= sogs nas/ gnyis su med pa thim par gyur/ sri mnan dril thun sngar ltar rgyob/

bzlog pa rgyas bsdus gang rung dang*/ drangs lhag chad brtan sogs mthar dbyung ngo/ mtshan thun mdun bskyed/ brub bskyed nas gzhung 'gros rang rang la thug pa dang 543) thun gzung*/ thun mthar dril thun rgyob/ gzhung srong pas thun gsum pa ltar/ ༈ phyi nyin skyabs sems nas/ gsol ka yan dang*/ smad las sngar ltar la/ byad gzhug la thun gzung*/ thun gnyis par smyor gzhug rnams 'don lugs snga ma'i rigs pas dpag thun gsum par/ smyor gzhug dran med mu cor smra bar gyur/ rjes su/ dug phur spu gri gnad kyi man ngag bdag dpal sras mchog khro tshogs= sha la rub pa ltar las byed par gyur/ zhes dang*/ gong gi dgra bo dngos su gsal ba'i snying nang du= rdul du brlag par gyur/ byang gter lhan thabs gzir dmigs/ drag sngags kyi 'od zer= kem song bar dmigs/ byur sri dril thun bzlog pa sogs sngar ltar/ ༈ phyir nang gzhung srong thun gsum pa'i dus tsam nas/ skyabs sems nas/ bsnyen mthar gsol ka btang ba'i bar bshags rjes/ smad las karma raṃ raṃ yan sngar ltar/ dug phur gyi/ bdag nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i g.yas kyi sor mo gnyis me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro bar gyur/ sgrub khog las/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: sogs nas/ rgya mdud kyi dkyil du hūm̐ mthing kha gsal bar gyur/ bar dang*/ zhus len las/ bdag 544) gtso bo'i thugs ka= tsha tsha 'phro zhing 'bab par gyur/ bar dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rdul brlag hūṃ: dam tshig= hūm̐ ka ra a aḥ bar dang*/ gnad 'phyang las/ sor mo rnams khro bo dang*/ lhag ma med par gyur/ zhes dang*/ ming gzhung rgyas pa der bzla/ byur sri'i gzir sngags/ dug phur gyi/ bdag rtsa ba pho rgyud khro bo= sems su gyur/ bdag dal gsum gyi mar gnas par gyur/ kho yi snying nang nas gzi brjid dang ldan zhing byin rlabs dang ldan par gyur/ bar dang*/ byang gter gyi/ hūm̐: sri las sna 'dren= gu gul sbyar ba btang*/

hūṃḥ chos kyi dbyings nas= brlag par mdzod/ bar dang*/ dug phur/ karma raṃ raṃ mtha'i/ ling ga dgra bo dngos su gsal ba'i= phung thal du song bar gyur/ bar dang*/ gnad 'phyang 'khor lo srog gi spu gri'i bca' thabs la/ oṃ badzra ki li ki la ya= sogs/ mgo/ lag g.yas g.yon/ rkang g.yas g.yon bcas la phur pa btab cing mnan yig de rnams dgu re bzla/ 'og gi ming gzhug 'bring po ci nus bzla/ dug phur gzhung gi phur pa dbal nas bzung ste klad la= gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra kī li ka la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa brgyad/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las= 'dus par gyur/ phur sgrom la/ slar yang 545) ye shes pa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ bdag gi thugs ka'i= sbyor mtshams su thim par gyur/ ki la ya brgya dang brgyad/ rnam shes a= sras su gyur/ mdun bskyed khro bcu'i phur gdab/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i= sogs nas/ yab yum bcu/ khra thabs/ pha bcu/ ma bcu/ sgo bzhi/ mtshon cha/ rdul brlag sngags gong ma man 'og ma brgya rtsa bzla/ byur sri mnan sngags/ dgu gsum/ mdun bskyed/ hūm̐: rdungs shig= sngags/ dgu tsam/ dug phur gyi/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul= rdul du brlag par gyur: mdun bskyed zhal bstab/ hūm̐: dam tshig= rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: bar dang*/ dug phur gyi/ dkyil 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs kyi zhal du re ma ti= rol bar gyur/ mdun bskyed/ oṃ badzra kī li= sogs nas/ skye mched bcu gnyis la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bdud 'dul gyi/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dam sri= nan: zhes brjod/ gzhung srong pas drag po'i sbyin sreg gtang*/ gzhung chen pas bzlog pa la 'jug ste/ hūm̐: gru gsum mthing nag= dgra la sgyur: bar dang*/ dbal mdos bzlog pa chen mo/ hūm̐: ma nor ma bcos= phye ma bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog: bar dang*/ khyung bzlog gsang rdzogs las byung ba/ khro ma ga ru ṭa= zos nas rdul du brlag par gyur: tshogs drang ba/ gzigs shig ma dang*/

gzhung gi 546) lhag ma byin rlabs dang*/ lhag ma gtang*/ rtsang gyer 'don/ bdag mdun gyi lha thams cad= bzlog sngags ci nus/ thun gtor 'bul zhing*/ hūm̐: ye shes phur pa'i= stong gsum stong gi= rdul du rlogs: bar ro/ bzlog pa grangs mang bsags kyang chog mnan par zab gnad rigs sbyar nas/ byang gter gyi/ kye/ sngon gyi las ngan= tshigs bcad dang dmigs pa bcas gtang*/ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i= rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las= sbyar ba gtang*/ mdos 'phyang rdzong 'debs g.yang len bar dang / gtor snod bhañdza= rtsa brgyud/ bstod pa zur 'gebs/ srung ma bskul pa bcas kyi mjug tu/ dam rdzas brgyan pa'i= rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las= sbyar ba btang*/ mdos 'phyang rdzong 'debs g.yang len/ hūm̐: bdud 'dul phur pa'i= rdzong 'debs/ g.yang len/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i= sogs kyi dngos grub blang*/ mdos dbang bskur/ zhal bsgyur/ shi sa brten phyi rol bla gab med pa'i sa nas/ dkar gtor/ gser skyems/ ye thog ma/ ra dge sogs kyang gtang*/ hūm̐: gzu dang dpang du= sogs gsang rdzogs las byung ba ltar/ las gzhung gi chad tho btang nas/ gang du 'phang ba'i sar phyin la/ dkar gtor/ shar la sogs pa'i sngon nam lha dbang*/ gsang rdzogs ltar/ srin mo za lam btang*/ hūṃ/ gzu dang dpang du= sogs gsang rdzogs las byung ba ltar dang*/ mdun bskyed/ brub bskyed/ 'gugs pa gsum/ bden chung bzhi/ rtsa brgyud gsum/ 547) phur thun tshom bskul dang*/ dbal mdos las byung ba/ hūm̐: gzhu 'di gnam lcags= sogs nas/ mda' 'ug sgro dang*/ rgod sgro dang*/ khra sgro/ bya rog sgro can dang*/ bse mdil can rnams/ rim par 'phang*/ hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje= sogs las byang gzhung bar rkang zor 'phang*/ hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje= 'og ma la/ nyi li li: zhes pa'i rjes su/ khrag thun rlangs pa chi li chi: srung ma= sogs nas/ dgra bgegs snying la khrag zor rgyob: ces bsgyur/

spu gri la zor gsham bcas kyis 'phang pa zor cha drug ka 'gres yin pas kha bsgyur/ dug thun rlangs pa chi li li: dgra bgegs snying la dug zor rgyob: ces dang*/ yungs thun mda' ltar sha ra ra: dgra bgaigs snying la yungs zor rgyob: ces dang*/ mtshe zor mda' ltar sha ra ra: dgra bgegs snying la mtshe zor rgyob: ces dang / rno zor rbab tu nyi li li: dgra bgegs snying la rdo zor rgyob: ces dang*/ mtshon rtse phur rtse rongs se rong: dgra bgegs snying la phur zor rgyob: ces dang*/ dug mda'i dbang phyug bskul pa/ byang*/ nub/ lho/ shar/ bcas mgo mthar lha sngags so sor sbyar ba bzhi/ stod mtha'i srung ma bskul pa/ mgo'i tshig bzhi'i sna drangs pa'i mas rim nas spu gri'i sngags sbyar bas 'phang*/ las byang srung 'khor skabs kyi khro bcu'i tshig dang sngags mas rim nas gtong ba 548) dang*/ zor gyi/ kye: zag med nges pa'i= dus la babaḥ yan gyis gtor chen 'phang*/ 'og gi hūm̐: nga ni mi g.yo= sogs kyis ri mgo gtub/ dmod/ hoḥ sku gsum dag pa'i= sogs mthar/ spu gri'i sngags dang mdos me nang phul la/ bzlog thung lan gsum bcas/ rten gtor/ a ka ros brlab/ las byang brtan ma gtang*/ chos nyid kyi bden pa= sogs dang*/ bro 'gugs lan gsum bcas/ rta bro gtang/ shis brjod bcas so/ mnan pa bya na/ mnan dong khar thon nas/ dkar gtor/ byang gtor sri mnan tshig kha bsgyur bas/ hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu yin= sogs/ zhabs 'og gzir ba dang ཿ king dmar kha bsgyur ba/ phyag g.yas phur bu bsnun pa= kha nang du= bar dang*/ sri mnan gyi/ bdag cag yon mchod= nṛ tri dzaḥ zhes pa'i rjes su 'gugs gzhug gsum/ bden chung bzhi/ bdud 'dul 'gugs dmigs/ 'gugs pa gsum/ sri mnan gyi/ hūm̐: sri mas= pa tsa hūṃ phaṭaḥ bar dang*/ byur sri'i gzir sngags gsum/ byang gter gyi/ hūm̐: gnod par byed pa'i= ma sdang zhigaḥ bar dang*/ king dmar las/ khong tshud=

nas grong khyer= sogs/ bar dang*/ byur sri'i mnan sngags/ king dmar gyi/ nam mkha' rlung me= sa ma ddhī:sa bar dang*/ badzra pa ṇi ma ma rakṣa/ byang gter gyi/ dang po chos kyi= rdzus la shog: bar dang*/ bdud 'dul gyi/ hūm̐ bhyo: dam sri bya ba'i= 549) nan: rang gzhung sgrub khog gi hūm̐: gcig ni= rdul du rlogs: bar dang*/ bro mnan shis brjod bcas/ nang du ldog nas/ rgyal rtags/ spyi bshags/ las byang mchod pa/ thabs kyi spyod pas= bstod pa dang*/ sku gsum dag pa'i= sogs kyis gsol ka bkyags/ gtor bzlog rkyang pa yin na rjes chog spyi ltar dang*/ bsnyen sgrub mthar sbrel ba yin na/ sgrub khog gi gter sbas/ chos nyid bden pa'i= sar phyin shog: oṃ badzra ratna padma karma siddhi hūm̐ bhrum̐ḥ zhes dang*/ shis pa brjod/ thugs sgrub sgrub khog las byung ba'i tshe sgrub/ bum pa bhruṃ las= bsnyen pa man/ rang gzhung sgrub khog las byung ba'i/ hūm̐: yang gsang bla med phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du: ngang du mu: zhes dang*/ yig brgya dbyangs gsal lan gsum/ ye dhar lan gsum/ sgrub khog las/ hūm̐:zhes brjod nas= dkyil 'khor lhar bcas sngar ltar wal gyis gsal bar gyur/ ki la ya nyer gcig bdag dpal chen yab yum= bya'o/ thugs sgrub sgrub khog gi hūm̐: rang lus= spyod lam bya'o: bar dang*/ a ka ro= 'bru gsum/ thugs sgrub sgrub khog gi hūm̐: ston pa'i spyan sngar= zhes dang*/ rang sngags la gtor sngags sbyar ba dang*/ arghaṃ= bstod par 'os pa= sgrub khog las/ kye ho: mgon po= 550)mdzad du gsol: badzra muḥ sgo byang sngags bsngos dang*/ badzra mūḥ khro bcu la sngags bsngos dang*/ bkra shis dge legs rgya mtsho= sogs bya'o/ rang gzhung mtha' rgyas/ hūm̐: thams cad sgrub pa'i= cha tshang bya/ thugs sgrub sgrub khog las byung ba/ rang lus me dpung= hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bar dang*/ hoḥ bsnyen sgrub las byung= swa ti bhrum̐ bhrum̐: bar brjod/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor=

sogs/ smon lam gdab pas legs par grub bo/ zhes pa 'di ni mdzod chen rnam lnga'i shing rta ba 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge me'i rdzu la zhugs pa rdo rje 'chang chen po rgyal sras blo gros mtha' yas kyis smad las dug phur nag po'i sgrub khog las/ khyad par do gal dgos pa'i skabs dug phur gyi gnad 'phyang las byung ba'i 'khor lo srog gi spu gri dang gab sprad cing*/ de ltar bgyi tshe spu gri sngags byang ma'i spel rgyas 'bring gang bder sbyar ba'i thun gzung ba'i dgos pa sogs ni ma bris pas dkyus la gang mos tsam gyis chog ces gsungs pa'i zab gnad khol du bton tshul/ rgyal dbang dpal yul ba'i phyag bzhes rgyun ltar 'di nyid du nges la/ gzhan du zab gnad de tsam du mi spro zhing phur pa rgyud lung gi dgongs pa mthil phyin pa ni rje de nyid kyi yig char blta dgos pa nyid do// zhes pa'ang nyer mkhor gyur pas dpal chen 'dus pas sngon byon dam pa'i phyag bzhes rang bzos ma bslad par bris pa dge legs 'phel/

551) na mo gu ru wa gin dra shṝ bha dra ye/ ratna'i phur pa'i gtor bzlog la/ hrīḥsngon= chab/ spos/ rnying sngon dang sbrel ba'i skyabs sems/ yan bdun/ maṇḍal/ dkar bgegs bcas/ las byang bka' bsgo nas/ lha bskyed/ pra marta na ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ mtshams su spro ba/ sgrub khog gi byug bdug brab gsum sngags/ pra khrid/ bdag nyid dpal chen du gsal ba'i= gtam par gyuraḥ hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi= sogs nas/ mchod pa mthar/ bstod pa zur 'gebs/ brgyud 'debs/ thugs dam chen po'i= rdo rjer bsgom pra khrid kyi/ bdag dang sras mchog gnyis kyi= ye shes gsal bar gyur: kī la bsnyen/ bdag dang sras mchog gnyis kyi sbyar nas/ dam can 'dus pa'i= ka taṃ ka ye bsnyen/ dug phur las/ bdag dpal chen po'i khro tshogs= las byed par bsam/ spu gri bzla/ mchod bstod bya/ mdun bskyed/ skad cig gis mdos gzhi= phyag 'tshal bstod: kī la cung zad bsnyen/ tshogs byin rlabs nas/ tshogs mchod/ yaṃ bskang*/ spro na/ skong rdzas/ rgyal ba spyi bskang*/ gzhung bskang bar bshags/ gsol kha/ gang zhig bcas/ badzra rakṣa du khaṃ: sogs/ 'gugs pa gsum/ bden chung bzhi/ rtsa brgyud gsum/ bdag gi thugs= sogs nas/ ho hoḥ dug mda' tshang ba'am/ lhu dang po/ hūṃḥ dam tshig chen po nas/ zhal bstab yan/ gtor bzlog/ dbal mdos 552) khyung*/ khro ma ga ru ṭa= brlag par bsgom/ drang ba/ lhag gam/ rtsang bzlog bdag mdun gyi lha= bdud pra/ brgya'am stong*/ nub mo/ ye shes phur pa'i= bzlog thung tshar gsum/ dkar gtor/ rtsa brgyud/ chad brtan/ na mo chos nyid= bro mnan/ badzra arghaṃ= thabs kyi= ma rnyed yongs su= ā li/ kā li/ yig rgya/ 'dir ni gzugs dang= su pra= bdag bskyed= thugs srog zhu= dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i= mi rnyed par gyur/ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yi= mi 'gyur lhun po= sogs shis brjod/ rgyal dkyil bya'o/ nyin tha mar/ bzlog sngags rjes su/ shar gyi phyogs kyi=

sgo dbye/ phaṭaḥ gtor snod= rtsa brgyud/ bstod pa zur 'gebs tshang ba/ rdo rje gzhon nu= dngos grub thob par gyur/ ye thog sogs/ chad tho/ ri khar/ dkar gtor/ za lam/ hūm̐: gzu dang dpang du= rim par nag 'gros/ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu 'go la tshar bzhi/ spu gri'i sngags kyis gtor chung nyer gcig 'phang*/ kye: zag med= dmod mthar/ spu gri' ི/ hūm̐: nga ni mi g.yo= 'di sku gsum dag pa'i mgor 'then srol yang 'dug bzlog thung tshar gsum/ brtan ma bro/ rjes bcad/ nang du bslebs nas/ a mye'i lugs kyis rgyal rtags 'don/ tshe 'gugs/ dngos grub/ mchod bstod phyin chad snga nyin ltar ro/ grong chog la dbal mdos mi 'don/ zhes pad nor pas so// 553) na mo gu ra ye/ phur pa'i sri mnan 'don 'grigs la/ las byang*/ mdun bskyed sbrags ma'i tshogs bskang ba gsol ka yan grub nas/ rig 'dzin bskul pa/ byang chub mchog tu= gser skyems/ brgyud gsum bla ma= mkhyen cig dgongs shig= sogs nas/ dpang mdzod cig: sri rabs / kye: dpal chen sri 'dul= las mdzod cig: bskul pa dug mda'i/ lhu dang po'am lnga pa yan chod/ phaṭaḥ raṃ e raṃ= sogs/ 'gugs pa tshar gsum/ bden chung gsum/ rtsa brgyud gsum/ na mo/ rtsa brgyud bla ma= tshar dgu tsam/ srin mo dga' yin= bsnyen pa'i dmigs pa le tshan gsum/ lhan thabs lta bur sbyar nas/ sri ma ra ya= oṃ badzra kī li= srin ngan gyi bla sha= sngags tshan gsum/ so sor brgya stong*/ sri rnams khugaḥ sems dpa' sangs rgyas= 'gugs pa tshigs bcad sngar ltar gsham sbrel/ gu gul sbyar nas/ dza tri brgya'am stong*/ dam nyams= sarba dri ni= brgya'am nyer gcig mchod bstod/ bskal pa me dpung= khro bo 'bar ba'i= tshig bzhi/ nam mkha' med par= sogs kyi thun dang po grub/ ༈ thun gnyis pa la/ rdo rje slob dpon= bdag nyied rdo rje srin po= bsnyen pa brgya'i/ gser skyems brgyud gsum bla ma/ tshig bzhi/ sri rabs nas/
sngar ltar ro/ de ltar thun bzhi drug mos/ rtags ma byung bar 'bad/ nub mo/ drang 554) lhag chad brtan sogs bya/
